title.en: Standing wave modes on a fixed string

summary: Reveal stationary nodes while particles of a string oscillate transversely.
objective: Create a fixed-end string with selectable harmonic number, nodes, antinodes and a slow-motion particle probe.
intent_signals: Create a fixed-end string with selectable harmonic number, nodes, antinodes and a slow-motion particle probe.
Reveal stationary nodes while particles of a string oscillate transversely.
example_prompts: Create a fixed-end string with selectable harmonic number, nodes, antinodes and a slow-motion particle probe.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of standing wave string with particle probe.
negative_signals: No damping, nonlinear tension change or energy transfer from a modeled driver.
not_for: No damping, nonlinear tension change or energy transfer from a modeled driver.

entities.name: String and supports
entities.guidance: Build a thin curve or tube between fixed clamps; sample densely enough to resolve the selected mode and keep the baseline visible.

entities.name: Nodes and envelope
entities.guidance: Mark x=j*L/n as stationary nodes; draw dotted amplitude envelopes without making them additional strings.

entities.name: Particle probe
entities.guidance: Highlight one fixed-x material point and its vertical trajectory; display wavelength 2*L/n and frequency n*c/(2*L).

state_contract.model: In SI units (length/displacement meters, time seconds), string length L>0, wave speed c>0, integer mode n>=1; y(x,t)=A*sin(n*pi*x/L)*cos(omega*t), omega=n*pi*c/L, with small amplitude relative to wavelength.
state_contract.authority: Mode number, amplitude and phase determine every sampled string point and probe; horizontal material coordinates remain fixed.
actions: Move a probe along the string.

invariants: Both endpoints and all declared nodes remain at zero displacement.
A material point moves transversely, not along the string toward the support.
Doubling mode number at fixed L and c doubles frequency.
motion_guidance: Time advances the analytic phase; do not scroll a static sinusoidal mesh horizontally and label it a standing wave.
A change in mode starts a new declared state or uses an explicitly labeled transition.
known_limits: No damping, nonlinear tension change or energy transfer from a modeled driver.
The resonance frequencies describe an ideal linear fixed-end string, not every real instrument.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: A fixed-end ideal string supports standing modes with nodes at both ends and frequencies that are integer multiples of c/(2*L).
claims.scope: Linear transverse waves with constant wave speed and fixed supports.

object_craft.structure: Build a thin curve or tube between fixed clamps; sample densely enough to resolve the selected mode and keep the baseline visible.
object_craft.material: Matte string, neutral supports and clearly differentiated dashed envelope; particle marker has a stable material identity.

physical_contract.scope: Analytic single standing mode of an ideal string.
colliders: No rigid-body colliders; any boundary is part of the declared mathematical model.
contact: No collision or impact response is supplied by this field model.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate the declared analytic state at paused or running model time; rendering never advances a second model.
checks: One-period playback restores every material point.
